advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Isolate the simulated dead-cwd test from the ambient cwd: `monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)` BEFORE patching os.getcwd, so the relative `.tickets-tracker` lstat cannot follow a real worktree symlink
evidence: tests/unit/test_detached_child_cwd.py:206-208: the new signature takes only `monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch` (tmp_path removed), and there is no `monkeypatch.chdir(...)` anywhere in the test body (lines 222-238)
tests/unit/test_detached_child_cwd.py:237: `assert detached_child_cwd(".tickets-tracker") == os.sep`: a relative path, resolved against the ambient cwd
src/rebar/_commands/init.py:589: `os.symlink(main_tracker, tracker)`: worktrees get a `.tickets-tracker` symlink to the main store
tests/unit/test_detached_child_cwd.py:82-87: the file's own docstring says worktrees symlink `.tickets-tracker` to the canonical store, "exactly as ``make worktree`` provisions one"

The removed version of this test did `monkeypatch.chdir(doomed)` into a tmp_path subdirectory, which isolated the relative resolution; the twin at tests/unit/test_detached_child_cwd.py:253-256 still does

Absence rationale: .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:420 runs `python-version: ["3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]`. In 3.11/3.12, posixpath.realpath calls _joinrealpath (an os.lstat on the relative name) before abspath() calls os.getcwd, so the result depends on what the invoking directory contains
advisory.finding: The simulated dead-cwd test resolves the relative tracker ".tickets-tracker" against whatever directory pytest is run from, because it no longer chdirs into an isolated directory. On Python 3.11/3.12, posixpath.realpath lstats the relative path before calling os.getcwd. Run from a worktree whose `.tickets-tracker` is a symlink to the absolute main-store path (what `rebar init` creates in worktrees), realpath follows the link to an absolute path and never calls the patched getcwd. The helper then returns the canonical store root rather than os.sep, and the test fails based on the invoking directory, not on the behavior under test.
scenarios: A developer runs `pytest tests/unit/test_detached_child_cwd.py` from a worktree provisioned by `make worktree` / `rebar init` on Python 3.11 or 3.12. `.tickets-tracker` is an absolute symlink, getcwd is never called, the helper returns the store root, and both assertions fail.
CI checkouts have no `.tickets-tracker` (it is gitignored), so the problem stays hidden in CI and appears only locally.
advisory.suggested_fix: Restore the `tmp_path: Path` parameter and call `monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)` as the first step, before `monkeypatch.setattr(os, "getcwd", ...)`. MonkeyPatch.chdir calls os.getcwd() to record the directory to restore, so it must run before the patch. The relative tracker then resolves inside an empty directory on every interpreter.
